patterns.strategy: Diagnose failing assertions and patch only when expected behavior is unambiguous.
Apply deterministic formatter/linter corrections without suppressing rules.
Repair the smallest compilation/configuration defect and preserve build semantics.

patterns.pattern: (?:ModuleNotFoundError|Cannot find module|ERESOLVE|No matching distribution|Could not resolve dependency|lockfile.*out of date)
patterns.strategy: Prefer compatible pin/lockfile repair; major upgrades require human review.

patterns.pattern: (?:Invalid workflow file|YAML.*(?:error|invalid)|Unexpected value|Unrecognized named-value|not allowed in reusable workflow|workflow is not valid)
patterns.strategy: Use deterministic workflow repair when available and open a PR for review.

patterns.pattern: (?:timed out|The operation was canceled|runner.*(?:lost|offline)|rate limit|Service Unavailable|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|502 Bad Gateway|503 Service Unavailable)
patterns.strategy: Re-run failed jobs within the bounded retry policy before escalating.
Never weaken scanning; preserve evidence and require human review.

patterns.pattern: (?:deployment failed|deploy-pages|Pages deployment|Azure login|kubectl|terraform apply|helm.*failed|environment protection rule)
patterns.strategy: Diagnose deployment/configuration state; infrastructure and credential changes require human review.
